name: DMBI TOPSIS 2025 Retrospective Validation
validation_type: Retrospective 2025 DMBI validation. Do not claim pristine prospective unseen DMBI validation.
decision_matrix: One matrix per target month x horizon: 25 districts x 3 burden criteria.
normalization: Min-max normalization to [0,1] inside each 25-district decision matrix.

topsis.positive_ideal: maximum weighted normalized value for each criterion
topsis.negative_ideal: minimum weighted normalized value for each criterion
topsis.ranking: descending closeness; rank 1 = highest relative priority

important_interpretation: DMBI is a relative district planning-priority score, not a malnutrition probability, clinical diagnosis, or official emergency threshold.
next_step: Step 29F applies the same frozen 2024 CRITIC weights and TOPSIS method to 2026-2030 future criteria.
